notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Herd Baloth.
You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth equal to the amount of life gained.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat from step 2.
